paper_id: Federated Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models__oa_W4403573412
title: Federated Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models
motivation: Edge-side FL consumes all local data causing excessive overhead and overfitting; public instruction data pool is near exhaustion
problem_framing: Federated data-efficient instruction tuning: select representative data subsets at intra/inter-client levels without raw data sharing
key_insight: Fusing features from all Transformer layers via t-SNE beats last-layer-only; hierarchical intra→inter clustering eliminates inter-client redundancy
method_signature: FedHDS: hierarchical data selection via fused multi-layer features + HDBSCAN clustering
evaluation_criteria: Rouge-L on held-out tasks, training speedup ratio vs full-data FL baselines
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Global selection (sending all features to server) causes poor accuracy due to suboptimal clustering on large-scale dataset
evidence_for_taste: the last layer is not universally optimal
global selection may cause poor accuracy
determining the optimal data ratio requires extensive experimentation
Coreset-Cent surpasses our approaches on the complex dataset
FedHDS on training set theoretically has certain disadvantages
thinking_moves: 从last-layer特征局限性反推需要融合多层特征
把数据冗余分为intra-client和inter-client两层处理
通过hierarchical selection避免global clustering的劣效
用自动确定的数据比例替代manual ratio搜索
承认 centralized 方法在复杂数据集上仍有优势
